issues.title: Filter 'SIDC' should not an edit field
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Filter 'SIDC' should not an edit field

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on 'Core Mapping' channel
3. Click 'Add' on 'Filter' bar
4. Select 'Sidc'
5. Notice 'Sidc' show as an edit field

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/01fe6913-b4ec-4409-8574-433a52e8a5ea)


## ⚙️ Expected behavior
'Sidc' filter should be a textbox without 'Edit' button. And we can input 'SIDC' code for filter.

## 🖥️ Screenshots


## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context

comments.body:
I think the existing implementation is valid @Tristina1788 

A user can use the `Edit` button to use the dialog to select which SIDC type they want to see filtered. (in addition to providing the raw text value)
